configurations.//: Serve the production build. Use this when exposing the app over a tunnel for phone testing: the dev server's HMR websocket lives on /_next/webpack-hmr, Next blocks it cross-origin by default, and the blocked upgrade makes cloudflared log 'malformed HTTP response' on a loop. Whitelisting via allowedDevOrigins would work but the tunnel hostname changes every session. Requires `npm --prefix web run build` first.
configurations.name: web-prod
